gloss: mitigation measure; easing measure; relief measure

definitions.gloss: mitigation measure; easing measure; relief measure
definitions.explanation: a policy, action, or plan designed to reduce the severity of a problem, ease restrictions, or relieve pressure on a situation

examples.japanese: {渋滞|じゅうたい}{緩和策|かんわさく}を{検討|けんとう}する。
examples.english: To consider measures to ease traffic congestion.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{新|あら}たな{緩和策|かんわさく}を{打|う}ち{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The government put forward new easing measures.

examples.japanese: {物価|ぶっか}{高騰|こうとう}に{対|たい}する{緩和策|かんわさく}として、{補助金|ほじょきん}の{拡大|かくだい}が{提案|ていあん}された。
examples.english: An expansion of subsidies was proposed as a mitigation measure against soaring prices.

notes:
Combines {緩和|かんわ} (easing, relaxation, mitigation) and {策|さく} (measure, policy, plan). A formal term from news and policy discourse, used for government and organizational responses to problems. Covers a wide range of contexts: economic policy, environmental measures, traffic solutions, and public health responses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金融|きんゆう}{緩和策|かんわさく}: monetary easing measures
- {規制|きせい}{緩和策|かんわさく}: deregulation measures
- {痛|いた}みの{緩和策|かんわさく}: pain relief measures
- {緩和策|かんわさく}を{講|こう}じる: to implement mitigation measures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {対策|たいさく}: countermeasure — a broader term for any measure taken against a problem
- {救済策|きゅうさいさく}: relief measure; rescue plan — emphasizes helping those already affected
- {解決策|かいけつさく}: solution — aims to fully resolve the issue, not just ease it
